name: PCI Payment Page Script Audit: requirement 6.4.3 and 11.6.1 on your checkout markup
subtitle: PCI DSS 4.0.1 requirements 6.4.3 and 11.6.1 have been mandatory since 2025-03-31, and the PCI SSC revised FAQ 1331 on 2026-08-04 so a QSA agreement alone no longer marks them not applicable. This reads a checkout page and names every script that has no authorization method, no integrity method and no inventory row.
free: Audit the checkout page you have open against all 26 PCI script-security rules - every script, every line, the requirement each one fails and the fix, no key asked.
paid: Export the dated 6.4.3 script inventory as the evidence file you hand the assessor, across every payment page in the repository, with CI output that fails a build when an unauthorized script appears.
need_key: This option needs a licence (PCI Payment Page Script Audit: requirement 6.4.3 and 11.6.1 on your checkout markup).
